ImageAcquisitionProtocol: Multiplexed sequential-round light-sheet imaging of one 1 mm thick mouse brain slice. Destriped, deskewed and stitched 3D volume (full stitched field, not cropped, not registered across rounds). Channel 1 = marker; channel 2 = Histone H3 protein from the same acquisition, in the same voxel frame, for registration across rounds.
OtherAcquisitionParameters: channel 1: 561 nm excitation; channel 2: 488 nm excitation (Histone H3), imaged in the same acquisition as channel 1
SoftwareVersions: converted from stitched TIFF slices with tifffile 2026.5.15 + zarr 3.4.2 (OME-Zarr 0.4, 6-level 2x2x2 mean pyramid)
